research.name: NumberFlow
research.note: Animated number component for React, Vue, Svelte and plain JS that spins each digit to its new value, with Intl formatting.

effects: per-digit odometer spin when the value changes
trend prop that forces digits to roll always up or always down
continuous plugin that makes digits pass through in-between numbers
NumberFlowGroup that syncs layout transitions between adjacent numbers
digits prop with per-position limits so 59 wraps to 00 in time displays

unverified: The homepage demo was loaded in a browser and seen rendering a number with a Shuffle button, but only as a still screenshot; the digit spin itself was not watched in motion.
The effects listed are taken from the documentation text on the homepage, not from frame-by-frame observation.
The README video (user-attachments asset) was not played.
requiresHostedService is false based on the docs describing it as a dependency-free npm component; no install was run.
